page_title: ARS 4-1 AST | Arsenal v Aston Villa 30/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Darren England is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa).
90+4' 4 - 1 Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) has a great chance inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.

90+4' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) went on a solo run, tricking his way past defenders, then produced an explosive blast from close range towards the bottom left corner. However, David Raya showed all his agility, deflecting the ball onto the post! What a save!

90+4' John McGinn (Aston Villa) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, David Raya shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!

90+3' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the right post.
90+1' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
86' The linesman signals that Ben White (Arsenal) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bukayo Saka trots off the pitch and is replaced by Noni Madueke (Arsenal).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ben White (Arsenal) comes onto the pitch for Jurrien Timber.
82' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Morgan Rogers is replaced by Jamaldeen Jimoh-Aloba (Aston Villa).
82' The substitution has been made. George Hemmings (Aston Villa) has replaced Youri Tielemans.
81' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) was quite harsh and Darren England didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar.
79' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.

78' 4 - 0 Leandro Trossard passes to Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom right corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 4:0.
77' Mikel Arteta has decided to substitute Gabriel and he is replaced by Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal).
77' Substitution. Viktor Gyökeres makes way for Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal).
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Aston Villa comes to nothing.
75' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Good work from Aston Villa as they win a corner.
73' Mikel Merino goes off the pitch and Christian Norgaard (Arsenal) comes on.
72' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Arsenal players have a reason to celebrate!
70' Wait! Referee Darren England has indicated he is going to review the Arsenal goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

69' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) fires a brilliant volley into the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, leaving the goalkeeper helpless. Jurrien Timber provided the assist. What a finish! 3:0.
67' A dangerous looking corner kick from Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is cleared to safety by the defence.

66' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Emiliano Martinez has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
65' Darren England couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) and blew his whistle.
61' Here is a change. Emiliano Buendia is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Andres Garcia (Aston Villa).
61' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jadon Sancho.
61' Close! Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar.
61' Arsenal win a corner.
60' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Arsenal.
59' Darren England interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Mikel Merino (Arsenal).
57' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) fires the ball from the free kick from medium range, but the goalkeeper does well to make a save.
52' 2 - 0 Goal! Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Martin Odegaard, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
50' Darren England sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
49' The Arsenal players halt their celebrations as referee Darren England makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

48' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Bukayo Saka delivers a teasing cross from the resulting corner and the ball falls into the space where Gabriel (Arsenal) is lurking. His close-range shot goes into the net and it's 1:0.
48' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
46' Unai Emery makes a half-time substitution. John McGinn comes on in place of Amadou Onana (Aston Villa).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
45+1' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
38' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Darren England who sees an offensive foul.
36' Great ball in from Leandro Trossard. Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post.
33' The corner from Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is cleared away by the defence.

32' Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes behind for a corner. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' Darren England blows for a foul after Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
30' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Darren England has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
27' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' The ball is laid off to Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom left corner and forces Emiliano Martinez to make a decent save.
22' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
21' The players claim that Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
20' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
18' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
15' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
13' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
12' The corner is swung in but Aston Villa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
12' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.

9' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Darren England with no other option than to blow for a foul.
7' A decent cross gives Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Darren England is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
